//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Passive Shield -> Config

Enable Passive Shield.//: Whether Passive Shield is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

hideShieldWhenNotInUse.//: When enabled, the shield will be hidden unless a player presses right-click.

passiveShieldPercentageDamageNegated.//: The percentage of damage that will be negated when a player is hit while holding a shield that's not held high. min: 0, max: 1
